create_clvp_feature_extractor: create a ClvpFeatureExtractor instance with custom feature_size, sampling_rate, and hop_length parameters
extract_fbank_features: extract log-mel spectrogram features from a raw numpy waveform array using the feature extractor
pad_and_truncate_audio: pad or truncate raw speech audio to a specified max_length with optional truncation and padding_value
return_attention_mask: return attention masks alongside input features when calling the feature extractor on raw speech
convert_to_tensors: convert extracted feature outputs to PyTorch or NumPy tensor format via return_tensors parameter
